findings.text: follow-on: a promoted shadow's stored row keeps shadow_controlled true beside shadow_contaminated because the mark is set after ledger.build_record at line 988, the exact contradiction the plan's section 1 describes; the join is only complete for pair_shadow_arms, and the file sits outside this node's declared write scope.

follow-on: _primary_review_record_paths returns the review records only inside `if base.is_file()`, so an .at-sha sibling whose base staging file is absent is never resolved and a shadow reading it is not marked.

follow-on: the review-record and worktree_retention surfaces of _primary_read_surfaces are resolved by untested code; only the run-directory surface is exercised (test_the_scan_runs_when_the_primary_cites_no_commit), so the promotion wiring a real scan depends on is unguarded.
follow-on: the regression row quotes slice00's 1719 passed as the whole cohort, while the manifest records 244 importing files across four slices, so the fragment understates the arm it reports.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base aa2110776; 08de78b03 is the source change, 4dfa456c6 the fixture and fragment anchor, 86164b4a5 the negative-control record, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_crew_shadow_contamination.py in both stream dialects, the committed fixture, the no-cited-commit scan, the pair verdict and the negative control; the manifest records 21 passed and a negative control at EXIT=1, and I re-ran that file at head 86164b4a and it reported 21 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a shadow's reads of its primary's run directory, review records or worktree make the pair contaminated and uncontrolled; reckon/ledger.py:2921 widens shadow_primary_read to the three record surfaces and reckon/capabilities.py:1013 joins the mark to the control verdict.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate at 21 passed, four importer slices with zero added failures, the isolated arms, the negative control and the ruff delta, and it names the promotion-path ordering as a follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the source node's declared write paths and compared against git diff --name-only aa2110776..86164b4a; every changed path (reckon/ledger.py, reckon/capabilities.py, reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py, the test file, the fixture, the evidence fragment) is inside them.

justifications.durability: the ledger-level branches redden if reverted (the negative control proves the pair guard) but the resolution layer in reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:1100,1122 carries no test, so a regression in the review-record glob or the worktree_retention read would pass the gate.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's measures are asserted in tests/test_crew_shadow_contamination.py (21 passed at head, re-run by me) and the negative control log shows EXIT=1 with test_a_contaminated_pair_is_uncontrolled failing, all recorded in the manifest.
justifications.fit: the additions extend the existing scanner in reckon/ledger.py:2882 beside its neighbouring helpers, and no plan, stage or version label appears in the changed source, tests or the fragment's element id.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:2921 and reckon/capabilities.py:1013 deliver the widened scan and the joined pair verdict, but the stored shadow_controlled remains stale in the real promotion path because reckon/crew/promotion.py:1181 computes the mark after build_record at line 988.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing one scanner (stream_tool_calls, shadow_primary_read) rather than adding a second, per the plan's own constraint; reckon/ledger.py:3023 _path_under restates trivial string containment that three private Path-based helpers (reckon/_worker_fence.py:952, reckon/hooks/worker_stop.py:178, reckon/mcp_census.py:114) already implement, none a shared owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only aa2110776..86164b4a lists only the declared write paths, and the evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/a-shadow-cannot-see-its-primary/shadow-reads-make-the-pair-uncontrolled.html is the contract-required landing anchor inside that scope.
